subject: Historic District Design Guidelines and South Street Outreach
overview: The commission reviewed and unanimously approved the Medford Historic District Design Guidelines to govern renovations and new construction in historic districts. The body also discussed a community outreach strategy for the proposed South Street Local Historic District, including educational messaging regarding the city's shipbuilding heritage.

items.title: Review of Medford Historic District Design Guidelines
items.summary: Commissioners reviewed a draft document intended to safeguard architectural heritage and historic neighborhood character.

items.title: General Approach and Replacement Materials
items.summary: The commission amended the guidelines to focus on visual qualities and design value rather than strictly requiring an identical match of physical properties for materials.

items.title: Modern Materials and Design Standards
items.summary: The body approved language allowing modern materials that resemble original historic features as closely as possible to provide flexibility for property owners.

items.title: Roofing, Solar Panels, and Windows
items.summary: Approved standards allowing synthetic roofing in hardship cases and required that solar panels and related wiring be installed discreetly. The commission also revised window guidelines to emphasize profile matching while striking language that strictly mandated wood materials.

items.title: Additions, Dormers, and Signs
items.summary: Members maintained requirements for new additions to be compatible in scale and subservient to original buildings, specifically updating language to include dormers and signage.

items.title: Approval of Design Guidelines
items.summary: The commission unanimously approved the Medford Historic District Design Guidelines as amended and authorized their publication on the city website.

items.title: South Street Historic District Outreach Plan
items.summary: Commissioners discussed a strategy to notify 18 property owners and approximately 300 abutters within 300 feet of the proposed South Street Local Historic District.

items.title: Educational Messaging and Promotional Strategy
items.summary: The body discussed creating a celebratory narrative regarding Medford’s shipbuilding history through a trifold brochure and dedicated webpage to build public support.

items.title: Action Items and Preliminary Study Report
items.summary: The chair tasked the commission's consultant with completing a required preliminary study report and assigned members to draft outreach materials for review at the April 13 meeting.
